ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilaterals ABCD, DCFE, and EFGH are three squares with side length of 1. Connect AC, AF, and AG. It follows that $\triangle ACF \sim \triangle GCA$. Find the degree measure of $\angle 1 + \angle 2 + \angle 3$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From (1) we have $\angle 1 = \angle \text{FAC}$.\\
Since quadrilateral ABCD is a square,\\
therefore $\angle 3 = 45^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle 2 + \angle \text{FAC} = \angle 3 = 45^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle 1 + \angle 2 = 45^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle 1 + \angle 2 + \angle 3 = \boxed{90^\circ}$.

Also because ∠1 = ∠FAC, so ∠1 + ∠2 = 45°. Thus ∠1 + ∠2 + ∠3 = 45° + 45° = 90°.
